entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

A yi kashetu, o a ko wɛ, ni mʋ mʋ yi teru , mʋn kia a mʋ, si a ta she mʋ. Lele kʋn tʋ a ye a bwəәnəә, mʋ yi dan mama tu an yi yinigəә tu, mi yi ŋoo mama tu. Wɛ di don da terəә, kʋ na da mʋ, wɛ din di joŋ tim, wɛ dim di kati wurəә tim.
